# `WorldApiMut::remove_gas`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-engine-side">engine-side</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **World API** (`src/plugins/api/world_api.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Removes gas proportionally from all substances in one cell.

## Signature

```rust
fn remove_gas (& mut self , cell : UVec2 , amount : u32) -> Result < GasMixture , WorldApiError >
```
